title: Domain Color Mapping
definition: A systematic mapping of different domains to unique and visually distinguishable colors.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine each topic in a conversation having its own color, like a rainbow. This makes it easier to understand and remember different ideas.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Domain-color mapping is a design technique that assigns unique colors to represent various subjects or disciplines. It enhances visual clarity and navigation in knowledge graphs or interfaces.
difficulty_levels.expert: Domain-color mapping is a design technique rooted in cognitive psychology. It leverages the human brain's ability to perceive and categorize colors more quickly and accurately than text or symbols. This technique enhances user experience by making knowledge graphs more visually engaging, intuitive, and accessible.

extra_fields.insight: The power of visual representation in organizing and presenting complex information.
